title: [v6.2] downgrade tags.cncf.io/container-device-interface to v1.1.0
body:
The new version injects idmap mount argument which makes it impossible to use for rootless podman. For now revert the version while figure a proper fix on main for v6.3.

Note we cannot change the main version in go.mod because our direct deps such as common and buildah also depend on the newer one. Thus a replace is needed for us to be able to downgrade the version.

ref https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/30233



#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

<!--

```release-note
Restore CDI support for rootless containers with user namespaces. https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/30233
```

comments.body: Note I am intentionally not submitting this for main for now as I hope we get a proper solution there until 6.3 but IMO for now the revert is the best choice.
